changelog:
v4.2.15 — A clear answer when a title isn't available

• Sometimes a show or season appears in the guide but your provider hasn't actually uploaded it yet. Until now that came up as a confusing "Server returned error 400. Try again" — so you'd keep retrying something that was never going to play.

• Now the app tells you plainly: the title isn't available from your provider right now, try another one or let them know. No more guessing, and no more retrying a dead end.

• We also tightened up how the app builds video links, so a bad or incomplete listing can't turn into a broken link behind the scenes.

• No change to playback or picture quality.

Includes everything from v4.2.14 and v4.2.13: the closing-app reporting in Send Debug Log, the fix for shows freezing mid-episode on Dolby titles, season and episode numbers on every screen, and the new logo.
